layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for discount codes

prompt.utterance: switch collaboration to CODE_WITH_ME, use the tony.md.md style again, and show me the revised plan before I decide whether to approve it.

graderOnly: The saved selector tony.md.md names .standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md.md. The other file, tony.md, is a different style with different contents. The display identifier (filename stem) of tony.md.md is tony.md, which used as a selector would resolve to the other file.
The user's 'use the tony.md.md style again' repeats the persisted, locked selection exactly; it is not a style change and needs neither a new cycle nor any change to User Style or User Style Locked.

The plan revision after DEV-001 changed build steps and dependencies only (rejection of unknown and expired codes split into new DEV-004); scope and design are unchanged. No implementation for DEV-002, DEV-003, or DEV-004 exists yet.
Active Work.BlockedOn holds the pending approval request for the revised plan; the user has not approved the revision.

all.why: repeating the style is not a reason for a new cycle
the revised plan still awaits approval
the collaboration switch is persisted in the plan
no style file renamed or replaced
completed step keeps its identity and status

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes on the committed tree, including after DEV-001
both style files exist and are different styles

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project: small Node ESM invoice CLI (src/totals.js, format.js, cli.js, bin/invoice.js) with 7 node:test tests. 10-styles: two developer user styles, tony.md and tony.md.md, with different contents. 20-design: Auditor CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-004) and design records; STATE at DEVELOPING after a FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. 30-plan: plan APPROVED, Mode STEPWISE, User Style tony.md.md, Locked true. 40-discount-table: DEV-001 implemented (src/discounts.js, config/discounts.json) with recorded self-check; plan IN_PROGRESS; BlockedOn a stepwise continue prompt. 50-plan-revision: at the user's request the plan was materially revised (rejection split into new DEV-004, DEV-002/DEV-003 changed and re-linked), Status back to PROPOSED with the style and lock unchanged; BlockedOn asks for approval of the revision. No recovery, policy FULL_DELIVERABLE, cadence AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE.
